hook_stat.sub: Vaishnavi Sharma's figures for Madhya Pradesh against Andhra Pradesh in the Senior Women's T20 Trophy

stats.label: Wickets in four consecutive balls — only the second Indian woman to do it in a T20
Wickets in two ODIs against Zimbabwe on her India comeback

diaspora_bullets: Leading wicket-taker at the 2025 Under-19 T20 World Cup
Left out of the World Cup squad, she rebuilt away from the team
news_summary: Left-arm spinner Vaishnavi Sharma took four wickets in four consecutive balls and finished with 6 for 22 for Madhya Pradesh against Andhra Pradesh in the Senior Women's T20 Trophy, days after taking nine wickets in two ODIs against Zimbabwe on her India comeback.
payoff: A bowler left out of the World Cup squad has returned with wickets in both international and domestic cricket.
